symptom: `grant read on M.E (FullName, Region)` fails with "mismatched input 'Region'"; `"Region"` works. Same for Status, Title, Value, Date, Label, … — names `create entity` accepts unquoted
cause: `entityMemberName` in MDLSecurity.g4 was `IDENTIFIER | QUOTED_IDENTIFIER`, the one name rule without `| keyword`; `Region` lexes as SCROLLREGION. An earlier fix answered the error with a "quote it" hint instead of accepting the name
insight: A name a statement can declare must be usable everywhere it is referenced; compare the slot with `attributeName` before adding hints. The keyword hint's tests moved to `workflowActivityName`, which still rejects bare keywords
